products.title: Pedal Insurance — 24-Month Repair Cover
products.descriptionHtml:
Two years of repair cover for pedals bought here, starting on the delivery date. Covers switch, jack and potentiometer failure, and accidental damage including liquid ingress and a dropped enclosure.

Choose the tier that matches the order you are covering: the Order Value option is the total purchase price the policy protects, and the premium is 10% of that. One claim per term. We pay return shipping both ways; if the pedal cannot be repaired we replace it with the same model.

  • Term: 24 months from delivery
  • Claims: one per term
  • Transferable: once, if you sell the pedal
  • Excluded: cosmetic wear, modification, third-party repairs

products._note: Three sizes (small/medium/large) already priced 1000/800/600. Prices left alone — the size axis is real and the existing spread is the merchant's call.
products.title: Floral Grass — Giclée Print
products.descriptionHtml:
A giclée print of the Floral Grass study, available in three sizes. Printed on 310gsm cotton rag with a matte surface and an unprinted border for framing.

Pigment inks rated for 100 years without noticeable fade under glass. Shipped flat between boards rather than rolled, so it needs no flattening before framing. Sold unframed; choose small, medium or large at checkout.

  • Paper: 310gsm 100% cotton rag, matte
  • Border: unprinted, for framing
  • Edition: open
  • Ships: flat, between boards

products._note: Single variant at CA$100. No size axis, so the copy stays size-agnostic.
